title: Implement planning updates and status changes
description: Add provider update and set-status operations for planning items. Update supports the complete mutable task metadata surface except status; omission preserves, explicit empty values clear permitted optional fields, supplied dependency lists replace and validate against the unified graph, and reusable assignments preserve caller order after canonical resolution. Set-status applies only the fixed revisable transition table and never creates execution timestamps. Both paths must keep createdAt stable, advance updatedAt monotonically, write atomically, and reject executable-task identifiers. Add no-op, clear, reorder, terminal-looking rejected reopen, invalid direct transition, dependency cycle, stale clock, and injected replacement tests.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Progress: traced planning contracts and flat-file transaction helpers; implementing provider update/set-status with locked union-graph validation, monotonic timestamps, no-op preservation, and atomic replacement coverage.
